description: Manages registry-based policy settings inside a GPO using Set-GPRegistryValue, Get-GPRegistryValue, and Remove-GPRegistryValue.

gpoName.description: Display name of the GPO that contains the registry-based policy setting.

key.description: Registry key path. Must start with HKLM or HKCU (or their full equivalents). HKLM targets Computer Configuration; HKCU targets User Configuration.

valueName.description: Name of the registry value to manage within the key.

type.description: Registry value data type. Required when ensure is 'Present'.

value.description: Registry value data. Use a string for String/ExpandString, an integer for DWord/QWord, an array of strings for MultiString, and an array of integers (bytes) for Binary. Required when ensure is 'Present'.

domain.description: FQDN of the domain containing the GPO. Defaults to the current user's domain.

server.description: FQDN or host name of the domain controller to contact. Defaults to the PDC emulator.

ensure.description: 'Present' configures the registry value in the GPO; 'Absent' removes the policy setting from the GPO. Defaults to 'Present'.

_exist.description: Whether the registry policy setting should exist. Deprecated — use 'ensure' instead.

policyState.description: Current policy state as reported by the GPO: Set, Delete, or NotConfigured (populated by get/test/set).

_inDesiredState.description: Indicates whether the current state matches the desired state (populated by test/set).
